item.title: Scratchd 10.0 is out for Mac
item.description: Scratchd is on the Mac App Store. $4.99, bought once, no subscription, and it needs macOS 26. Notes, tasks, saved links, journal entries and drawings are plain files in a folder you choose, with no account and nothing collected. The iPhone version is in review; that one purchase will cover iPhone, iPad and Apple Watch.

item.title: Scratchd is coming
item.description: Scratchd is a notes app for Mac, iPhone, iPad and Apple Watch. Every note is a plain file in your own iCloud Drive, with no account and nothing tracked. It arrives at version 10; the first nine were used every day and never sold. Coming to the App Store at $4.99, bought once.
